Windows SFML dependency notices
================================

These unaltered notices accompany the external dependencies in the pinned
SFML 2.6.2 Windows build. manifest.json records their source URLs and SHA-256
hashes. Full upstream license files are preserved; comments extracted from
SFML headers preserve the copyrights/notices present in that exact archive.

Bundled versions identified from the pinned x64 DLL/library bytes and headers:
  OpenAL Soft 1.18.1  https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft/tree/openal-soft-1.18.1
  FreeType 2.5.5     https://github.com/freetype/freetype/tree/VER-2-5-5
  libogg 1.3.2       https://github.com/xiph/ogg/tree/v1.3.2
  libvorbis 1.3.4    https://github.com/xiph/vorbis/tree/v1.3.4
  FLAC 1.3.1        https://github.com/xiph/flac/tree/1.3.1

OpenAL Soft is shipped as a separate openal32.dll, which can be replaced by
a compatible build. Its complete upstream source, including build files, is
available at the versioned source URL above and as this archive:
  https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft/archive/refs/tags/openal-soft-1.18.1.tar.gz

Portions of this software are copyright (c) 2014 The FreeType Project
(www.freetype.org). All rights reserved. The FreeType license is included
in freetype-2.5.5-ftl.txt; additional original notices are retained alongside it.

The minimp3, stb_image and stb_image_write notices are copied from the headers
used by SFML. The Khronos GLAD/Vulkan header notices and Apache 2.0 license
are also retained. See the separate sfml-license.md and csfml-license.md for
the wrapper libraries' own terms.
